verses_en.wbw: sei preme — with that prema; garagara — brimming; matoyala hana — intoxicated; hunkara garjana kare — roars and thunders; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping

verses_en.text:
Hearing that roar, the age of Kali that lay senseless —
all regained consciousness, and the joy was immense.
verses_en.orig:
সেই গর্জন শুনি অচেতন কলিকাল ।
চেতন পাইয়া সভে আনন্দ বিশাল ॥ ৫৯৭ ॥
verses_en.translit:
sei garjana śuni acetana kalikāla |
cetana pāiẏā sabhe ānanda biśāla || 597 ||
verses_en.wbw: sei garjana shuni — hearing that roar; achetana kalikala — the senseless age of Kali; chetana paiya sabhe — all regained consciousness; ananda vishala — the joy was vast

verses_en.text:
Therefore, crying "Radha-Krishna", they dance, weep and laugh;
the darkness went away and they found light.
verses_en.orig:
তেঞি রাধাকৃষ্ণ বলি নাচে কান্দে হাসে ।
অন্ধকার দূরে গেল পাইল প্রকাশে ॥ ৫৯৮ ॥
verses_en.translit:
teñi rādhākṛṣṇa bali nāce kānde hāse |
andhakāra dūre gela pāila prakāśe || 598 ||
verses_en.wbw: teni — therefore; radhakrishna bali — crying "Radha-Krishna"; nache kande hase — they dance, weep, laugh; andhakara dure gela — the darkness went away; paila prakashe — they gained light

verses_en.text:
Krishna, born in the Dvapara, [now] in a golden body
awakened the senseless people of the Kali.
verses_en.orig:
দ্বাপরে উপজে কৃষ্ণ গৌরময় তনু ।
কলি অচেতন লোক করাইল চেতন ॥ ৫৯৯ ॥
verses_en.translit:
dbāpare upaje kṛṣṇa gauramaẏa tanu |
kali acetana loka karāila cetana || 599 ||
verses_en.wbw: dvapare upaje krishna — Krishna, born in the Dvapara; gauramaya tanu — in a golden body; kali achetana loka — the senseless people of Kali; karaila chetana — awakened

verses_en.text:
The Lord reveals prema, assuming a humble guise;
He gives Himself away and counts it His own gain.
verses_en.orig:
প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে প্রভু করি দীনভাব ।
আপনা বিলায় আপে মানে নিজ লাভ ॥ ৬০০ ॥
verses_en.translit:
prema prakāśaẏe prabhu kari dīnabhāba |
āpanā bilāẏa āpe māne nija lābha || 600 ||
verses_en.wbw: prema prakashaye prabhu — the Lord reveals prema; kari dinabhava — assuming humility; apana vilaya ape — gives Himself away Himself; mane nija labha — counts it His gain

verses_en.text:
What lord ever showed such lordship?
He gives prema even to those who do not worship Him — without discrimination.
verses_en.orig:
এহেন ঠাকুর কোন্ কৈল ঠাকুরাল ।
না ভজিলে প্রেম দেয় নাহিক বিচার ॥ ৬০১ ॥
verses_en.translit:
ehena ṭhākura kon kaila ṭhākurāla |
nā bhajile prema deẏa nāhika bicāra || 601 ||
verses_en.wbw: ehena thakura — such lordship; kon kaila thakurala — what lord ever showed; na bhajile — even to those who do not worship; prema deya — He gives prema; nahika vichara — without discrimination

verses_en.text:
That is why I say: this is the avatara of the yuga;
and He also manifested this full avatara.
verses_en.orig:
এতেক বোলিয়ে যুগ-অবতার এই ।
এই পূর্ণ অবতার প্রকাশিল সেই ॥ ৬০২ ॥
verses_en.translit:
eteka boliẏe yuga-abatāra ei |
ei pūrṇa abatāra prakāśila sei || 602 ||
verses_en.wbw: eteka boliye — therefore I say; yuga-avatara ei — this is the yuga-avatara; ei purna avatara — this full avatara; prakashila sei — He manifested

verses_en.text:
In other Kali-yugas, however, there is an avatara of Narayana;
His name is Krishna, as in the Dvapara-yuga.*
verses_en.orig:
আর কলিযুগে নারায়ণ-অবতার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণ দ্বাপরযুগে নাম সে তাহার ॥ ৬০৩ ॥
verses_en.translit:
āra kaliyuge nārāẏaṇa-abatāra |
śrīkṛṣṇa dbāparayuge nāma se tāhāra || 603 ||
verses_en.wbw: ara kaliyuge — in other Kali-yugas; narayana-avatara — an avatara of Narayana; shrikrishna — Sri Krishna; dvaparayuge — [as] in the Dvapara-yuga; nama se tahara — such is His name
notes: That is, in ordinary Kali-yugas the yuga-avatara is "krishna-varna", dark in colour (cf. Bhagavata 11.5.32 and Sridhara Svami's comment: "shining like sapphire"). The line is corrupt in A; the reading of the 1983 edition is adopted; its exact sense is unclear.

verses_en.text:
His colour surpasses a parrot's wing —
"the lustre of sapphire", says the commentator.
verses_en.orig:
শুকপক্ষ-পাখা জিনি বরণ যাহার ।
ইন্দ্রনীলমণি-দ্যুতি কহে টীকাকার ॥ ৬০৪ ॥
verses_en.translit:
śukapakṣa-pākhā jini baraṇa yāhāra |
indranīlamaṇi-dyuti kahe ṭīkākāra || 604 ||
verses_en.wbw: shukapaksha-pakha jini — surpassing a parrot's wing; barana yahara — whose colour; indranila-mani-dyuti — the lustre of sapphire; kahe tikakara — says the commentator

verses_en.text:
In this Kali-yuga Gaurachandra is the full Brahman,
and the portion [— the yuga-avatara —] entered into Him: this is the essence I have told.*
verses_en.orig:
এই কলিযুগে গৌরচন্দ্র পূর্ণব্রহ্ম ।
অংশ প্রবেশিল ইথে কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ৬০৫ ॥
verses_en.translit:
ei kaliyuge gauracandra pūrṇabrahma |
aṃśa prabeśila ithe kahila e marma || 605 ||
verses_en.wbw: ei kaliyuge — in this Kali-yuga; gaurachandra purnabrahma — Gaurachandra is the full Brahman; amsha praveshila ithe — the portion entered into Him; kahila e marma — I have told this essence
notes: Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 4.8–12): the dharma of the age is established by a portion of the Lord, the yuga-avatara; but when Krishna Himself descends, all the avataras, the yuga-avatara included, enter into Him.

verses_en.text:
Chaitanya Gosani is the fullest of full avataras;
there is no one else who is such an ocean of compassion.
verses_en.orig:
পূর্ণ পূর্ণ অবতার চৈতন্য গোসাঞি ।
এহেন করুণানিধি আর কেহ নাঞি ॥ ৬০৬ ॥
verses_en.translit:
pūrṇa pūrṇa abatāra caitanya gosāñi |
ehena karuṇānidhi āra keha nāñi || 606 ||
verses_en.wbw: purna purna avatara — the fullest of full avataras; chaitanya gosani — Chaitanya Gosani; ehena karunanidhi — such an ocean of compassion; ara keha nani — there is no one else

verses_en.text:
Karya-avatara and yuga-avatara are one in Him;
therefore, in accordance with the yuga, Gaura is manifest before our eyes.
verses_en.orig:
কার্য-অবতার যুগ-অবতারে এক ।
যুগ-অনুরূপ তেঞি গৌর পরতেখ ॥ ৬০৭ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kārya-abatāra yuga-abatāre eka |
yuga-anurūpa teñi gaura paratekha || 607 ||
verses_en.wbw: karya-avatara yuga-avatare eka — karya-avatara and yuga-avatara are one; yuga-anurupa — in accordance with the yuga; teni — therefore; gaura paratekha — Gaura is manifest before the eyes

verses_en.text:
The shastras say: in the Kali [the avatara] is golden, the dharma is sankirtana;*
this is the Lord Vishvambhara, and no one else."
verses_en.orig:
কলি পীত সঙ্কীর্তন-ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
এই বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু কভু আন নহে ॥ ৬০৮ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kali pīta saṅkīrtana-dharma śāstre kahe |
ei biśbambhara prabhu kabhu āna nahe || 608 ||
verses_en.wbw: kali pita — in the Kali, golden; sankirtana-dharma — the dharma is sankirtana; shastre kahe — the shastras say; ei vishvambhara prabhu — this is the Lord Vishvambhara; kabhu ana nahe — none other
notes: "Pita" means yellow, golden; cf. Bhagavata (10.8.13): Garga Muni speaks of the three former colours of the avataras — white, red and yellow (pita) — and the Gaudiya Vaishnavas see in "yellow" an indication of Gauranga.

verses_en.text:
Having reflected, all the pandits became firm in heart;
and the Lord, understanding the time, restrained Himself.
verses_en.orig:
বিচারি পণ্ডিত সব দঢ়াইল হিয়া ।
আপনা সম্বরে প্রভু সে কাল বুঝিয়া ॥ ৬০৯ ॥
verses_en.translit:
bicāri paṇḍita saba daṛhāila hiẏā |
āpanā sambare prabhu se kāla bujhiẏā || 609 ||
verses_en.wbw: vichari — having reflected; pandita saba dadhaila hiya — all the pandits became firm at heart; apana sambare prabhu — the Lord restrains Himself; se kala bujhiya — understanding the time

verses_en.text:
Then in a moment the Lord withdrew it all,
and Vishvambhara Gaurahari spoke [as usual].
verses_en.orig:
সব সম্বরিল প্রভু তিলেকে তখন ।
বিশ্বম্ভর গৌরহরি উঠিল বচন ॥ ৬১০ ॥
verses_en.translit:
saba sambarila prabhu tileke takhana |
biśbambhara gaurahari uṭhila bacana || 610 ||
verses_en.wbw: saba sambarila prabhu — the Lord withdrew everything; tileke takhana — then in a moment; vishvambhara gaurahari — Vishvambhara Gaurahari; uthila vachana — speech arose (He spoke)

verses_en.text:
All the people whisper to one another about the wondrous event;
guessing this way and that, they go off here and there.
verses_en.orig:
সব লোক কাণাকাণি অপরূপ কথা ।
সাতে পাঁচে অনুমানি যায় যথা তথা ॥ ৬১১ ॥
verses_en.translit:
saba loka kāṇākāṇi aparūpa kathā |
sāte pāṁce anumāni yāẏa yathā tathā || 611 ||
verses_en.wbw: saba loka kanakani — all the people whisper; aparupa katha — about the wondrous event; sate panche anumani — guessing this way and that; yaya yatha tatha — go here and there

verses_en.text:
Some remained in amazement, with doubt in their hearts:
"What have we seen? What lies behind Vishvambhara's deeds?"
verses_en.orig:
আশ্চর্য থাকিল কারো সন্দেহ হৃদয় ।
কি দেখিল বিশ্বম্ভর-চরিত্র-আশয় ॥ ৬১২ ॥
verses_en.translit:
āścarya thākila kāro sandeha hṛdaẏa |
ki dekhila biśbambhara-caritra-āśaẏa || 612 ||
verses_en.wbw: ashcharya thakila karo — some remained amazed; sandeha hridaya — with doubt in their hearts; ki dekhila — what have we seen; vishvambhara-charitra-ashaya — the intent behind Vishvambhara's deeds

verses_en.text:
What they had heard from people about Vishvambhara
they saw with their own eyes: He is the Creator of the world.
verses_en.orig:
লোকমুখে যে শুনিল বিশ্বম্ভর-কথা ।
সাক্ষাৎ দেখিল এই জগত-করতা ॥ ৬১৩ ॥
verses_en.translit:
lokamukhe ye śunila biśbambhara-kathā |
sākṣāt dekhila ei jagata-karatā || 613 ||
verses_en.wbw: lokamukhe ye shunila — what they had heard from people; vishvambhara-katha — about Vishvambhara; sakshat dekhila — they saw directly; ei jagata-karata — this is the Creator of the world

verses_en.text: The town overflowed with joy, all cry "Jaya, jaya!";
verses_en.orig:
আনন্দে ভরল পুরী দেই জয় জয় ।
ধন্য গোরাগুণগাথা এ লোচনে গায় ॥ ৬১৪ ॥
verses_en.translit:
ānande bharala purī dei jaẏa jaẏa |
dhanya gorāguṇagāthā e locane gāẏa || 614 ||
verses_en.wbw: anande bharala puri — the town overflowed with joy; dei jaya jaya — they cry "jaya, jaya"; dhanya goraguna-gatha — the blessed song of Gora's glories; e lochane gaya — this Lochana sings
